correctness.rationale: Exact sink event expansion over independent vertex sets of Cn gives G_n(z)=sum_k n/(n-k) binom(n-k,k)u^k(z-1)^k; G_n(0)=p^n+(1-p)^n are exactly two cyclic orientations. Q=(G-G(0))/z has degree <=2 for n<=7; exact discriminants strictly positive for n=6,7 for all 0<u<=1/4. At n=8,p=1/10, integer cubic coefficients 6561,556956,6389766,21523356 give negative exact discriminant -548120008099593420688656. Independent symbolic discriminants and rational orientation formula checked; no extension to all graphs claimed.
